methodology: Listed all 2,041 public repositories from the official Adafruit organization, then selected 712 hardware/PCB/EAGLE candidates by repository name or description.
Read recursive Git trees at pinned source commits; matched literal board filename after removing collection duplicate suffix ##n and optional __n.
Computed raw local board Git blob SHA-1 without uploading local boards; byte-for-byte matches distinguished from filename-only candidates.

Read root README/LICENSE/COPYING/NOTICE documents via official GitHub Git blob objects. Exact version is assigned only from an explicit legal-code title or canonical license URL; no version is guessed.

No source match or detected license automatically grants graph redistribution clearance. Historical-version matching, license scope, attribution, embedded components, and release compliance require further review.
limitations: Only official Adafruit repositories whose name or description signaled PCB, hardware, or EAGLE were tree-scanned; missing sources remain unresolved.
Byte-identical board matches identify a pinned source board; they do not alone establish the entire graph conversion chain or all rights in embedded libraries.
Filename-only matches identify candidates, including Eagle-version resaves and possible historical designs; they are not verified exact source matches.
Detected root-level license declarations may apply to different parts of a repository. Multiple declarations require scope review.
Attribution header retention and modified-work notices remain to be packaged and reviewed before dataset redistribution.
The audit does not apply a new collection-wide license and clears zero graph files for public redistribution.
